jobs.description: Position Overview Investment professional working within Apollo's Private Investment Grade team, part of the Global Investment Grade business, focused on the origination, structuring, underwriting, execution, and ongoing management of illiquid investments across developed markets. The team has a format-agnostic mandate covering 4(a)(2) private placements, bilateral and club senior secured loans and forward-flow structures, infrastructure and project finance, and secondary purchases, with the objective of earning excess spread over comparable public investment grade for the additional complexity and illiquidity. The Associate will focus on valuation, transaction modelling, deal execution, and maintaining portfolio positions including ongoing relationships with issuers. The role works cross-functionally with portfolio managers, the IG sector analysts and Performing Credit analyst team, High Grade Corporate Solutions, Apterra, ABF, legal, compliance, and operations, and combines elements of principal investing and structured finance. It requires a high level of technical ability, analytical rigour, and creativity. Primary Responsibilities Support origination, structuring, underwriting, and execution of private investment grade transactions across developed markets, working with deal team members and counterparties including Apollo's IG sector analysts, Performing Credit analyst team, Corporate Solutions, Apterra, ABF, Hybrid Value, risk, legal, and insurance solutions groups; external advisors (accountants, consultants, industry advisors, investment banks); and counterparties (corporate executives, lenders, agents, investment banks). Build and maintain historical and projected financial models of companies (valuation analysis) and transactions (transaction cashflow analysis, scenario and downside cases, structural waterfalls) to support origination and underwriting. Conduct independent fundamental credit analysis on new transactions, including financial statement analysis, capital structure assessment, industry evaluation, and management quality review; prepare and present investment recommendations to the Investment Committee, including credit memos with clearly articulated risk and reward assessments, relative value positioning, and covenant analysis. Assign and maintain internal credit ratings for new and existing holdings, with clear documentation of rating rationale and watch and trigger considerations; assess relative value versus comparable public investment grade alternatives, incorporating spread, structure, covenant, and liquidity considerations. Evaluate deal terms, financial covenants, and legal documentation; support covenant negotiation alongside internal and external legal counsel with a focus on appropriate downside protection; manage end-to-end deal execution from initial screening through closing, coordinating with agents, borrowers, lead banks, internal legal, compliance, and operations. Develop fluency across documentation conventions relevant to private investment grade and standard market terms across issuer types and structures. Partner with High Grade Corporate Solutions, Apterra, ABF, and other Apollo origination channels on evaluating and executing deal flow; build familiarity with the bank, agent, sponsor, and direct issuer landscape across developed markets to contribute to pipeline discussions and deal screening; participate in relationship-building with banks, agents, and issuers alongside senior team members. Maintain assigned portfolio positions through financial performance tracking, covenant compliance testing, amendment and waiver evaluation, and early identification of credit deterioration; act as a primary point of contact for issuers post-close on monitoring requests, amendments, consents, and routine engagement. Update internal credit ratings as borrower circumstances evolve; prepare watchlist recommendations, rating action rationale, and amendment and waiver evaluations for portfolio manager and IC review. Coordinate with the IG sector analysts and Performing Credit analyst team on sector coverage, shared issuer analysis, and cross-market relative value assessments; leverage IG sector and Performing Credit research views and data to inform private investment grade underwriting, pricing, and relative value analysis; contribute to unified IG research output where relevant, including sector reviews, watchlist discussions, and thematic presentations. Partner with teams across the broader Apollo credit platform (Hybrid Credit, ABF, Performing Credit, FIG) where transactions or credits span multiple products. Ensure analytical work and deal recommendations incorporate the relevant regulatory considerations across US (NAIC/SVO, RBC, Schedule D) and European (Solvency II, matching adjustment, fundamental spread) mandates; flag balance-sheet constraints (concentration limits, quality thresholds, admitted asset and matching adjustment treatment) during underwriting; coordinate with internal and external teams on rating and regulatory filings, including private letter rating documentation for lead investor positions. Contribute to the team's process and AI tooling agenda, including deal screening, underwriting templates, surveillance dashboards, and AI-enabled workflows. Qualifications & Experience 3-6 years of relevant work experience, ideally in one or more of the following: investment banking (leveraged finance, M&A or restructuring), buy-side corporate or infrastructure private credit. Bachelor's degree with an exceptional record of academic achievement. CFA charterholder or progress toward designation preferred; MBA or advanced degree a plus. Valuation experience required: comfortable independently building and defending company and position valuation and transaction cashflow models. Strong modelling, analytical, valuation, and problem-solving skills; advanced skills in Excel-based financial modelling; familiarity with Bloomberg, BlackRock Aladdin, or comparable systems. Demonstrated ability to independently analyse and recommend credits across corporate sectors, with exposure to infrastructure, project finance, or asset-backed structures a plus. Hands-on experience with covenant review and documentation across at least one of: private placements, syndicated or club loans, or structured credit. Familiarity with insurance balance-sheet investing (NAIC/SVO, RBC, Solvency II) a plus; willingness to develop the gaps essential. Demonstrates strong investment judgement by ability to identify potential risks and find solutions to roadblocks throughout all stages of a deal. Excellent attention to detail; strong written and verbal communication suited to credit memos, IC presentations, and external counterparty interactions; ability to frame a recommendation clearly and defend it under scrutiny. Ability to manage multiple concurrent deal processes under tight timelines without sacrificing quality. Intellectual curiosity and willingness to develop expertise across new sectors, structures, and markets as the platform evolves; comfort working in a complex and fast-moving organisation across multiple stakeholders and capital pools. Excels in a rigorous and fast-paced team-oriented work environment. About Apollo Apollo is a high-growth, global alternative asset management and retirement services platform with a track record of investment excellence. In our asset management business, we seek to provide our clients with excess return at every point along the risk-reward spectrum from investment grade to private equity with a focus on three core investment strategies: yield, hybrid, and equity. For more than three decades, our investing expertise across our fully integrated platform has served the financial return needs of our clients and provided businesses with innovative capital solutions for growth. Through Athene, our retirement services business, we specialize in helping clients achieve financial security by providing a suite of retirement savings products and acting as a solutions provider to institutions. Our patient, creative, and knowledgeable approach to investing aligns our clients, businesses we invest in, our employees, and the communities we impact, to expand opportunity and achieve positive outcomes. Our Purpose & Core Values Our clients rely on our investment acumen to help secure their future. We must never lose our focus and determination to be the best investors and most trusted partners on their behalf. Accordingly, we strive to be: The leading provider of retirement income solutions to institutions, companies, and individuals. The leading provider of capital solutions to companies. Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.
Role Overview
The Coupang Intelligent Cloud (CIC) organization is building the next-generation cloud platform that powers Coupang's rapidly expanding business. CIC provides the foundational infrastructure, cloud services, platform capabilities, and operational excellence that enable engineering teams across the company to innovate at scale.
As a Senior Staff Technical Program Manager, you will drive large-scale, cross-functional initiatives spanning cloud infrastructure, compute, networking, storage, AI infrastructure, platform services, operational excellence, reliability, capacity management, and cloud business growth. You will partner closely with engineering leaders, principal engineers, product leaders, finance, security, and operations teams to define strategy, build execution plans, and deliver business-critical outcomes.

You will lead complex programs that influence the direction of CIC, establish scalable operating mechanisms, and ensure alignment across multiple organizations. You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership while driving execution with urgency and accountability.
The ideal candidate can speak the language of engineers, understand large-scale distributed systems and cloud infrastructure, influence without authority, and navigate ambiguity while delivering measurable results.

Lead strategic, organization-wide programs across cloud infrastructure, platform services, AI infrastructure, reliability, security, and operational excellence.
Define program strategies, success metrics, execution frameworks, and operating mechanisms that scale across the CIC organization.
Drive end-to-end program ownership from vision, planning, and roadmap development through execution and operationalization.

Drive large-scale platform transformations involving architecture modernization, reliability improvements, automation, and operational efficiency.
Establish governance mechanisms, executive reviews, risk management processes, and business reporting frameworks.
Identify organizational bottlenecks, process inefficiencies, and system gaps, and implement scalable solutions to improve execution.

Build strong partnerships across engineering, product, security, finance, procurement, and business teams to achieve company objectives.
Drive executive-level communications, presenting program status, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to senior leadership.
Establish and continuously improve operational excellence practices across engineering teams.
Mentor TPMs and contribute to the growth of program management excellence within CIC.

12+ years of experience leading large-scale technical programs in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, enterprise platforms, or related technology domains.
Proven experience driving organization-level initiatives across multiple engineering teams and stakeholders.
Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, networking, storage, compute platforms, and modern software development practices.
Experience managing highly complex cross-functional programs with significant technical and business impact.
Demonstrated ability to define strategy and translate ambiguous business objectives into executable plans.
Experience driving programs across the full software development lifecycle, from concept through deployment and operational support.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage metrics and data to influence decisions and measure outcomes.
